title: 第533章 暗中恶意第532章 文脉之种
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道并未在太师父处久留。
他留下了三百道流转着混沌气息的符文，足以供超凡社团全员完成两次功法转修；
又将极阳、极阴玄液各十份交予老，太师父，这些资源足以催生出十数位三境强者。
至于小悠朵，他并没打算将其留在晨曦学府。
这丫头的身份太过敏感，犹如黑夜中的火炬，极易引来圣光教那些狂热信徒的疯狂扑杀。
若真如此，不仅会连累学府内的普通学员，更会将晨曦学府深藏的秘密彻底掀开。
届时学府将成为众矢之的，局面将一发不可收拾。
“哥哥，我们要去哪里呀？”小悠朵嘴里含着奶糖，腮帮子鼓鼓的，歪着脑袋问道。
“去找你林岚姐姐，顺便给你介绍两个新伙伴。”
“真的吗？哥哥我们快点！”小悠朵瞬间来了精神，小脸上满是期待，拉着林道的手便往前跑。
林道任由她拉着，心中却闪过担忧。
小悠朵掌世间光明，小苍月掌幽冥轮回，这两股力量体系截然不同，甚至隐隐相克。
这两个小丫头初次见面，该不会直接掐起来吧！
牵着小悠朵穿过防御阵法，从学府大门离开。
这道阵法只拦进不拦出，从内向外畅通无阻。
晨曦学府府门暗处，隐匿着不少学府潜修的高手，境界大多在先天五品之上，正警惕地注视着四周。
林道正欲抱起小悠朵施展瞬步离去，敏锐的见闻色霸气，忽然感知到四周泛起几缕隐晦的恶意。
他眉梢微挑，神识顷刻间如潮水般覆盖四面八方，很快便锁定了恶意的源头——自己被人盯梢了。
学府外，绿意盎然的林间走廊上，一名长相谄媚的男子正用余光不时扫向大门，眼中满是急切。
当见到林道走出的瞬间，他立刻惊喜转身，压低声音对着通讯器道：“大人，目标人物已经出现。”

“嗯，表现得自然些，别被发现。
对方极有可能是后天八重境以上的体修，对危机的感知极为敏锐。”
林道眯眼打量着那道远去的背影，嘴角勾起一抹玩味的弧度。
后天四重境就敢来盯梢！
这不过是个探路的小喽啰，真正要对他出手的大鱼，还藏在暗处。
“小悠朵，坐稳了，哥哥带你去河里摸鱼！”
林道一把将小悠朵抱起，让她骑在自己宽阔厚实的肩膀上。视野瞬间开阔，小悠朵双眸亮晶晶的，小脸上满是兴奋，一双小手使劲挥舞，声音如银铃般清脆：“哥哥，快！我们快去河里摸鱼！”
……
江海市某处，隐蔽的豪华别墅庭院内。
佣人们各司其职，精心打理着这座奢华的宅邸。
“根据帝京传来的绝密情报，帝家于三天前便派遣了大量先天五品境以上的高手，秘密潜入江海市，目标人物正是林道。”
侍女辰女身材娇小，却努力挺直腰杆让自己显得成熟些，此刻正紧绷着俏脸汇报情况。
藤椅上，柳月颜正慵懒地躺着啃肉包子，闻言直接“垂死病中惊坐起”，俏脸上满是惊愕：“你说什么？帝家要对林道出手！”
下一秒，她直接笑喷，眼泪都从眼角滑落：“哈哈哈哈！帝家这是派人来送菜吗？
那坏家伙还真倒霉，刚回来就被这种恶心玩意沾上了。
本姑娘真想去看看他现在的表情。”
辰女眼中闪过一丝讶异。
这懒女人平日里眼高于顶，如今竟对林道推崇备至，能让这女人看上眼，那林道绝非凡俗。
content_en:
Lin Dao did not stay with the Grand Master for long.
He left behind three hundred runes filled with the aura of chaos, enough for all members of the Extraordinary Society to complete two training transfers;
He also handed over ten portions of the extremely yang and extremely yin mystical fluids to the old master. These resources were enough to give birth to more than a dozen strong men in the third realm.
As for Xiao Yuduo, he had no intention of leaving her at Chenxi Academy.
This girl's identity is too sensitive. Like a torch in the dark, she can easily attract the crazy followers of the Holy Light Sect to kill her.
If this is true, it will not only affect the ordinary students in the academy, but also completely expose the deep secrets of Chenxi Academy.
At that time, the school will become the target of public criticism, and the situation will be out of control.
"Brother, where are we going?" Xiao Yuduo asked, tilting her head with toffee in her mouth, her cheeks bulging.
"Go find your sister Lin Lan and introduce you to two new partners."
"Really? Brother, let's hurry up!" Xiao Yuduo suddenly became energetic, her face was full of expectation, she took Lin Dao's hand and ran forward.
Lindao let her pull him, but worry flashed in his heart.
Xiao Youduo controls the light of the world, and Xiao Cangyue controls the reincarnation of the underworld. These two power systems are completely different, and even vaguely contradict each other.
When these two little girls met for the first time, wouldn't they start fighting?
He led Xiao Yuduo through the defensive formation and left from the school gate.
This formation only blocks entry but not exit, and is unobstructed from the inside to the outside.
In the darkness of the gate of Chenxi Academy, there are many hidden masters of the academy, most of whom are above the fifth level of Xiantian, watching the surroundings with vigilance.
Lin Dao was about to pick up Xiao Yuduo and use Instant Step to leave. With his keen sense of domineering, he suddenly sensed some vague malice surrounding him.
He raised his eyebrows slightly, and his consciousness instantly covered all directions like a tide, and he quickly located the source of the malice—he was being watched.
Outside the school, on the green forest corridor, a flattering-looking man was glancing at the door from time to time with his peripheral vision, his eyes full of eagerness.
When he saw Lin Dao walking out, he immediately turned around in surprise, lowered his voice and said to the communicator: "Sir, the target person has appeared."
“Well, act natural and don’t get caught.
The other party is most likely to be a physical practitioner at the eighth level or higher of the acquired realm, and has an extremely keen sense of crisis. "
Lin Dao squinted his eyes as he looked at the retreating figure, with a playful arc at the corner of his mouth.
Dare to follow the fourth level of the day after tomorrow!
This is just a little guy looking for a path, and the big fish that really wants to take action against him is still hiding in the dark.
"Xiao Yuduo, sit still, my brother will take you to fish in the river!"
Lin Dao picked up Xiao Yuduo and let her ride on his broad and thick shoulders. The field of vision instantly broadened. Xiao Yuduo's eyes were shining, her little face was full of excitement, her little hands were waving vigorously, and her voice was as clear as a silver bell: "Brother, hurry! Let's go fish in the river!"
…
Somewhere in Jianghai City, in the courtyard of a hidden luxury villa.
The servants perform their duties and take good care of this luxurious mansion.
"According to the top-secret information from the Imperial Capital, the Imperial Family sent a large number of masters above the fifth-level Xiantian Realm three days ago to secretly sneak into Jianghai City. The target person was Lin Dao."
The maid Chennu is petite, but she is trying to straighten her waist to look more mature. At this moment, she is reporting the situation with a tight pretty face.
On the wicker chair, Liu Yueyan was lying lazily munching on meat buns. After hearing this, she immediately "sit up in shock as she was dying". Her pretty face was filled with astonishment: "What did you say? The Di family is going to take action against Lin Dao!"
The next second, she burst out laughing, tears falling from the corners of her eyes: "Hahahaha! Is the Di family sending someone to deliver food?
That bad guy was so unlucky that he got stained with this disgusting thing right after he came back.
This girl really wants to see his current expression. "
A trace of surprise flashed in Chen Nu's eyes.
This lazy woman usually has high eyesight, but now she admires Lin Dao so much that she can be attracted to him. Lin Dao is absolutely extraordinary.。
